summary: Frontend-only testing for 3 targeted bug fixes: (1) Guest comment sheet CTA button visibility, (2) HTML entity decoding in game titles, (3) Real-time comment count badge update. All 5 requested test scenarios PASSED.

issues: Some game titles have trailing whitespace (e.g., 'Blush Fashion Girl Room ', 'Stop The Lock ') - likely from source data, minor cosmetic issue

Titles 'Maze Survivor   Platform Adventure Game' and 'Archery Master   Bow and Arrow' show 3 spaces instead of em-dash separator — the data source appears to already have stored 3 spaces rather than – entity (pre-existing data issue, not a code bug)
decodeHtml() does not handle   entity — if data sources contain   it would render as raw text. No current titles show this issue.

passed_tests: TEST 1 PASS: Guest comment sheet - Login button bounding box y=708 bottom=748, viewport=844px, FULLY VISIBLE (not clipped by bottom nav). Sign Up button also fully visible.
TEST 2 PASS: HTML entity decoding - all 82 game titles scanned, zero raw HTML entities (–, &, <, >, etc.) found. 'Bridge Rush – Draw Bridge Puzzle Game' shows en-dash correctly.
TEST 3 PASS: Comment sheet backdrop z-index=500 > bottom nav z-index=50 — bottom nav is blocked when sheet is open.
TEST 4 PASS: Close button (data-testid=comment-close-btn) dismisses comment sheet; backdrop + sheet both removed from DOM.
TEST 5 PASS: Clicking backdrop area above the sheet (mouse.click at y=288) closes the comment sheet successfully.

TEST 6 PASS: Logged-in (admin) comment flow — comment input shown (not guest CTA), comment posted, appears in sheet list, comment count badge on feed card increments from 0 to 1 immediately after onCommentPosted callback fires.
critical_code_review_comments: decodeHtml() missing   handler — add .replace(/ /g, '\u00A0') or " " to be safe if game data from external sources may contain
Backdrop onClick fires correctly but clicking via Playwright requires explicit mouse coordinates above the sheet due to z-index stacking — expected browser behavior, not a bug
seed_data_creation: 2 test comments posted to game 6caad3fd-e01d-4fc6-9253-e7e796520a6b (Bridge Rush) during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bug fixes verified working: (1) z-[500] on backdrop+sheet + paddingBottom calc(80px+safe-area) ensures guest CTA buttons visible at y=708 in 844px mobile viewport. (2) decodeHtml() strips all common HTML entities from titles/descriptions. (3) onCommentPosted callback in page.tsx increments commentCounts state in real-time. Mobile viewport 390x844 used throughout. Admin login uses button[type=submit] (data-testid=login-submit). Guest via button:has-text('Guest') on /welcome.
rca_of_issue: Previous bug: Guest CTA buttons (Login/Sign Up) were hidden behind the frosted glass bottom nav (z=50) because the comment sheet input area lacked sufficient bottom padding. Fix: sheet and backdrop raised to z-[500] so they sit above the nav (z=50), and paddingBottom set to calc(80px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) which pushes buttons 80px above bottom edge, well above the nav pill. Verified: Login button bottom edge at 748px in 844px viewport, nav starts at ~808px.
